text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word came in that Oguri Cap and Super 
Creek would be making their full-fledged 
comeback after the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One pumped herself up, determined to 
build the strength at this training camp 
to beat the two of them.
